propositions: Transport parameters in reconciler core modules are unannotated or annotated as Any, preventing mypy from enforcing port contract at call sites
Annotations through the rebar_reconciler.* shim import path resolve to Any under ignore_missing_imports, silently disabling attribute checks despite appearing to be typed
Relative imports within the package (from ._backend import TicketTransport) resolve correctly and restore mypy attribute checking without requiring class restructuring

Mypy detects capability member call sites (add_comment, set_relationship) that the AST audit cannot catch because hasattr sees them via metaclass attributes, making static checking strictly stronger than runtime audit
The custom metaclass _TransportPortMeta is exonerated: it serves runtime isinstance honesty and does not block mypy enforcement when the import path is resolved
